review: Agent-reviewed against complete canonical card text/all faces from the stated Oracle snapshot; independently reviewed again during implementation. Bounded positives are not exhaustive corpus relevance. No remote generated answers supplied labels. See docs/evaluation.md.

questions.question: Delver of Secrets transforms into Insectile Aberration

qrels.name: Delver of Secrets // Insectile Aberration
qrels.rationale: Front face reveals instant or sorcery to transform; back face is Insectile Aberration with flying.

questions.review: Reviewed BOTH face texts; one canonical card, not two printing or face results.

questions.question: A flying bird that can tap to make mana of any color

qrels.name: Birds of Paradise
qrels.rationale: Creature Bird, flying, tap to add one mana of any color.

questions.review: Reviewed complete text and creature subtype; named positive directly satisfies all requested abilities.

questions.question: A creature I can sacrifice to fetch a basic land onto the battlefield tapped

qrels.name: Sakura-Tribe Elder
qrels.rationale: Self-sacrifice activated ability searches a basic land and puts it onto the battlefield tapped.

questions.review: Self-sacrifice is explicit, rather than merely an enters-the-battlefield land trigger.

questions.question: Get two basic lands from my library, one tapped on the battlefield and one in my hand

qrels.name: Cultivate
qrels.rationale: Search up to two basic lands; one enters tapped and the other goes to hand.

qrels.name: Kodama's Reach
qrels.rationale: Same two-basic-land outcome; Arcane subtype does not change relevance.

questions.review: Reviewed both complete texts; both explicitly satisfy each destination.

questions.question: A creature that destroys an artifact or enchantment when it enters

qrels.name: Reclamation Sage
qrels.rationale: Enters trigger may destroy target artifact or enchantment.

questions.review: Naturalize was inspected and excluded: instant, not a creature or enters trigger.

questions.question: An artifact creature that finds a basic land when it enters and draws a card when it dies

qrels.name: Solemn Simulacrum
qrels.rationale: Artifact Creature with both the basic-land enters trigger and card-draw death trigger.

questions.review: Both effects belong to one card; no inferred combo or rules ruling.

questions.question: A creature that lets me sacrifice another creature to scry

qrels.name: Viscera Seer
qrels.rationale: Sacrifice a creature: scry 1, without a mana or tap cost.

questions.review: Carrion Feeder inspected and excluded: sacrifice puts a counter, it does not scry.

questions.question: An instant that sacrifices an artifact or creature to draw two cards and make a Treasure

qrels.name: Deadly Dispute
qrels.rationale: Sacrificing artifact or creature is an additional cost; draw two and create Treasure.

questions.review: Village Rites inspected and excluded: no artifact option or Treasure.

questions.question: A cheap instant that looks at the top card, can put it in the graveyard, then draws a card

qrels.name: Consider
qrels.rationale: Surveil 1 followed by draw a card; one mana Instant.

questions.review: Opt inspected and excluded: scry moves to bottom rather than graveyard.

questions.question: Creatures that sacrifice artifacts for value

qrels.name: Atog
qrels.rationale: Sacrifice artifact for temporary +2/+2; red Creature mana value 2.

qrels.name: Goblin Engineer
qrels.rationale: Activated ability sacrifices artifact to return an artifact; red Creature mana value 2.

qrels.name: Goblin Welder
qrels.rationale: Ability makes controller sacrifice an artifact and returns another; red Creature mana value 1.

questions.review: Review covers artifact sacrifice as either cost or resolving action; no requirement for a free outlet.

questions.question: A black instant that destroys a creature

qrels.name: Doom Blade
qrels.rationale: Black Instant mana value 2; destroys target nonblack creature.

qrels.name: Infernal Grasp
qrels.rationale: Black Instant mana value 2; destroys target creature with life-loss downside.

questions.review: Query does not require destroying any color of creature, so Doom Blade remains relevant. Murder inspected and excluded by mana-value cap.

questions.question: A white sorcery that destroys all creatures

qrels.name: Wrath of God
qrels.rationale: White Sorcery mana value 4; destroys all creatures and prevents regeneration.

qrels.name: Day of Judgment
qrels.rationale: White Sorcery mana value 4; destroys all creatures.

questions.review: Exact inclusive boundary mana value 4; regeneration clause is not required.

questions.question: A colorless artifact creature that returns another artifact from my graveyard to my hand when it dies

qrels.name: Myr Retriever
qrels.rationale: Colorless Artifact Creature mana value 2; death returns another artifact to hand.

qrels.name: Junk Diver
qrels.rationale: Colorless Artifact Creature mana value 3; flying and same death recursion.

qrels.name: Scrap Trawler
qrels.rationale: Colorless Artifact Creature mana value 3; own death triggers return of an artifact with lesser mana value.

questions.review: All reviewed positives satisfy both Artifact and Creature; conditional lesser-mana-value recursion is allowed by the question.

questions.question: A one-mana black and green creature that grows when I sacrifice artifacts or creatures

qrels.name: Ravenous Squirrel
qrels.rationale: Both black and green; hybrid one-mana cost gives mana value 1; sacrifice trigger adds counter.

questions.review: Colors are BOTH B and G despite hybrid cost; exact multicolor case, inclusive mana value 1.

questions.question: A green creature that adds Squirrels whenever I make tokens

qrels.name: Chatterfang, Squirrel General
qrels.rationale: Green Creature; replacement effect creates extra Squirrels when tokens would be created.

questions.review: Canonical colors are G while color identity includes B due to activation. Color controls must use colors, not commander identity.

questions.question: What is the current cheapest shop price for a near-mint foil Lightning Bolt?
questions.review: No canonical card text can establish current seller prices, condition, or foil printing choice. Empty qrels mean unsupported by this evidence corpus, not proof that no related card will retrieve.

questions.question: Which card guarantees I will win every tournament regardless of my deck and opponent?
questions.review: No reviewed card text supports a universal competitive guarantee. This is a refusal/insufficient-evidence probe; do not assign a useful-card ranking score.
